payload.body: You tend to move toward new roles, communities, or plans that let a previously hidden part of you participate. Growth feels less like performing improvement and more like becoming recognizable to yourself. You usually understand that development does not require becoming more conventional. This makes it easier to choose opportunities that expand your life without asking you to erase what motivated the change.
